text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Warp FFT (N = 128 = 4 × 32): one warp per (channel, beam), no shared memory, no barriers
1 each lane loads 4 samples n = j + 32k

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start

g.text: (4-byte X,Y loads: 128 B per warp per k)

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 4 for each q, a 32-point FFT across the lanes:

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start
font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start

g.text: summed over the 8 segments in registers
butterfly pattern across lanes (8 of 32 lanes and
3 of 5 stages shown): each lane trades values with
lane l xor h, then adds or subtracts and multiplies
by a twiddle; no shared memory, no __syncthreads
Before: 64-thread blocks, 7 synchronised stages × 8 segments = 56 __syncthreads per block of data → 0.50 ms per 6.7 ms block.
Warp kernel: 0.30 ms (1.66×), ~167 GB/s, close to memory-bound; matches a reference DFT to < 1e-4.
